title: ARWP Next.js Search Pack v0.2
purpose: Keep Next.js source-level Search/deployment risk separate from final build evidence, then reconcile deterministic App Router ownership with the actual static export artifact when one exists.

rules.claim: Static export is an explicit deployment mode and must not be inferred from the presence of App Router source alone.
rules.decision: Classify literal output: 'export' as static-export; keep other literal modes as dynamic-or-unspecified, and keep computed output configuration explicitly unresolved. Never treat deployment mode as a ranking signal.

rules.claim: Features that require request-time or Node.js server behavior are unsupported by Next.js static export.
rules.decision: When static export is explicit, fail on inspectable unsupported config/runtime features such as rewrites, redirects, headers, Proxy/middleware, numeric ISR/revalidation, Draft Mode, Server Actions, non-GET/request-dependent Route Handlers, intercepting routes, dynamicParams=true and dynamic routes without inspectable generateStaticParams evidence. Keep computed revalidate state as review rather than guessing it.

rules.claim: Static metadata and generateMetadata are server-resolved declarations; source presence alone does not prove the final emitted metadata values.
rules.decision: Inventory static metadata/generateMetadata ownership and metadataBase/htmlLimitedBots signals, but use the final Search Build Gate artifact to prove emitted title/canonical/robots/Open Graph/JSON-LD values.

rules.claim: Next.js metadata exports are supported in Server Components, not Client Components.
rules.decision: Fail when a file is inspectably marked 'use client' and also exports metadata or generateMetadata.

rules.claim: Raw JSON.stringify output can require sanitization before embedding untrusted strings into JSON-LD script content.
rules.decision: Watch when a Next.js source visibly embeds application/ld+json with JSON.stringify but no inspectable less-than escaping/sanitizer evidence. Keep custom sanitizer cases as review rather than automatic failure.

rules.claim: Generated out/dist HTML is not source authority, but it is the correct evidence for what a static export actually emits.
rules.decision: When a final static artifact is supplied, compile it with Production Search Build Gate and keep source diagnostics and artifact failures as separate evidence lanes.
